description:
Make an HTTP request to any endpoint. HTTPayer automatically handles x402 payment using your credits if required. Supports GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH.

Use this tool when:
- Calling an x402 endpoint discovered via search_endpoints or known (e.g. InvestBud)
- Any fetch returns 402 Payment Required — retry immediately through here, never give up

Do not use for plain open endpoints that don't require payment.
